title: The Split Protocol Decides the Result: Re-Evaluating Encrypted Traffic Classification
abstract: arXiv:2611.06290v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Encrypted traffic classifiers are routinely reported at 95-99% accuracy. We show that on one of two public corpora, the same model and code score macro-F1 0.992 under the evaluation protocol standard in the literature and 0.567 under a protocol that keeps flows from one packet capture on one side of the split. Nothing changes but the partition (gap 0.426 over eight seeds, p = 0.008 after Holm-Bonferroni correction).   The inflation is not a property of random splitting as such. On a month of backbone QUIC traffic, we evaluate five split protocols at eight seeds each: random, temporal and client-disjoint splitting are statistically indistinguishable from session-disjoint, while server-disjoint splitting costs 0.192 macro-F1 (d = 17.0, p = 0.008). Which axis matters depends on how the corpus was collected, in a way invisible from its label space.   We give a diagnostic that identifies the right axis before any model is trained: single-id

translated_title: 分割协议决定结果：重新评估加密流量分类
translated_abstract: 加密流量分类器通常被报告具有95-99%的准确率。我们表明，在两个公开语料库之一上，相同的模型和代码在文献标准的评估协议下得到宏F1 0.992，而在一种将来自同一数据包捕获的流量保留在分割同一侧的协议下仅得到0.567。除了数据划分方式外没有任何改变（八个随机种子上的差距为0.426，经Holm-Bonferroni校正后p = 0.008）。这种虚高并非随机分割本身的属性。在一个月的骨干网QUIC流量上，我们以每个协议八个种子评估了五种分割协议：随机、时间序和客户端不重叠分割在统计上与会话不重叠分割无法区分，而服务器不重叠分割会损失0.192的宏F1（d = 17.0，p = 0.008）。哪个划分轴重要取决于语料库的收集方式，而这从其标签空间中无法看出。我们提供了一个诊断方法，可以在训练任何模型之前识别出正确的划分轴。
tldr: 该论文揭示加密流量分类报告的高准确率主要由数据分割协议决定——同一模型在不同分割协议下宏F1可从0.992骤降至0.567，且关键划分轴取决于语料库的收集方式，并提出了一个无需训练模型即可识别正确划分轴的诊断方法。
en_tdlr: The paper demonstrates that reported accuracy in encrypted traffic classification is largely determined by the split protocol—the same model scores macro-F1 0.992 versus 0.567 under different splits—and introduces a diagnostic that identifies the correct split axis before any model is trained.
